name: mapcv
description: Build remote-sensing training datasets (segmentation, detection, instance segmentation) from a region, imagery and labels. Adds the mapcv skill and its MCP server.

allow_write.title: Let the agent write datasets
allow_write.description: Off: the agent can inspect labels, validate configs and plan, but writes nothing. On: it can also save configs, generate datasets and re-split them, inside the folder Claude Code was started in.
